# Scalixo Media

> Scalixo Media is a digital marketing and growth agency based in Ahmedabad, India. The website describes its marketing, creative, and web services, shares selected work, and provides company and contact information.

Use the links below as a guide to public information on the website. For the most current page inventory, see the [XML sitemap](https://scalixomedia.com/sitemap.xml).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://scalixomedia.com/): Overview of Scalixo Media and its services.
- [About](https://scalixomedia.com/about.html): Company information, principles, and founder's note.
- [Portfolio](https://scalixomedia.com/portfolio.html): Selected work, case studies, and live digital marketing projects.
- [Contact](https://scalixomedia.com/contact.html): Office address, phone number, and inquiry information.
- [FAQ](https://scalixomedia.com/Faq.html): Frequently asked questions about pricing, timelines, and services.

## Services

- [Social media marketing](https://scalixomedia.com/socialmedia.html): Complete management, content creation, and platform strategies.
- [Performance marketing](https://scalixomedia.com/performance.html): Paid ad campaign frameworks, funnel design, and ROAS targeting.
- [SEO services](https://scalixomedia.com/seo.html): Technical audits, on-page optimization, and local SEO focus areas.
- [Website development](https://scalixomedia.com/web.html): Conversion-focused web design, UI/UX, frontend development, and CMS setup.
- [Branding and identity design](https://scalixomedia.com/branding.html): Visual systems, guidelines, and core brand asset packages.
- [Influencer marketing](https://scalixomedia.com/influncer.html): Creator collaborations, trusted brand voices, and UGC campaigns.
